name: Carnegie Library (1912)
notes: Interpretation (no reference image): a small 1912 Beaux-Arts Carnegie library in buff brick on a raised ashlar base; a projecting pedimented entry pavilion with two columns in antis, bronze doors and a lunette over a flight of eight steps with lamp standards; tall arched windows with stone keystones; stone corner pilasters, entablature, a balustraded parapet and a low verdigris dome over the reading room. The site-specs method puts the front toward Fourth Street (heading 87.6) although the address is on Third Street.
